title: Explore the roads to the station sites: read every system on the way to Aldebaran, Yildun, Hawthorne and Alchiba, and those beside them
note: Kept by Oracle; written 2026-11-16 23:21 UTC for the explorers (rule F26; orders.log ENT-019: P4 and block ORACLE). The roads from scripts/map.py route nexus_prime <site>: to Aldebaran (9 jumps) by gsc_0050, brachium, gsc_0049, acrab, duskfield, giausar; to Yildun (11) by brachium, nightveil, marfik, regor, groombridge_34, chalawan, rasalhague; to Hawthorne (13) and Alchiba (14) past giausar by gsc_0028, gsc_0006, gsc_0042, avior. The systems already on census-frontier or census-worked stay there; this list holds the 14 never read on the roads, nearest site first, then 14 lawless systems one lane off a road (game/map/galaxy.tsv), none an empire system and none a stronghold. A never-read system is taken in list order; once read, every 480 minutes. Each system is read first by one ship with an empty hold (rules F3, F13); the census kind has flown 165 frontier runs without a loss (data/routes/runs.jsonl). Chalawan holds a HEXC outpost and GSC-0040 an ENDL outpost, both without a market (data/station/stations.json). What each read finds goes into the system file in game/planets/ the same turn.
